morphology.pattern_note: 作为外语人名不作马来语词缀拆分。所列 IPA 为英语常见读法，不代表已确立的马来语标准读音；具体人名应尊重本人读法。

senses.zh_definition: 兰登：英语人名，可作名字或姓氏；在马来语文本中作为专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: Landon, an English personal name or surname used as a proper name in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang dalam bahasa Inggeris yang boleh digunakan sebagai nama diri atau nama keluarga.
senses.nuances: 输入包未提供原句，不能确定具体所指。正文应写 Landon；不能将其解释成普通马来语词，也不能自动改为 London。英语读音及名字用法参见 [Behind the Name：Landon](https://www.behindthename.com/name/landon)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报：影视文化介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Michael Landon dikenali menerusi peranannya dalam siri televisyen Little House on the Prairie.
dual_scenarios.zh: 迈克尔·兰登因在电视剧《草原小屋》中的角色而广为人知。
dual_scenarios.en: Michael Landon is known for his role in the television series Little House on the Prairie.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流：讨论电视剧
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok drama Michael Landon tu?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah menonton drama lakonan Michael Landon itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你看过迈克尔·兰登演的那部剧了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you watched that show with Michael Landon?
spoken_features: kau 是熟人之间的第二人称

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak tengok siri lama lakonan Michael Landon malam ni. Kau nak tengok sekali?
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu menonton siri lama lakonan Michael Landon malam ini. Adakah kamu mahu menontonnya bersama saya?
messages.zh: 我今晚想看迈克尔·兰登演的老剧。你要一起看吗？
messages.en: I'm going to watch an old Michael Landon series tonight. Want to join me?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak! Aku dah lama tak tengok siri tu.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya mahu. Saya sudah lama tidak menonton siri itu.
messages.zh: 要！我好久没看那部剧了。
messages.en: Sure! I haven't watched that series in ages.

etymology.historical_story: Landon occurs as an English given name and surname, so its appearance in Malay need not indicate a borrowed common word. One familiar bearer was Michael Landon, whose television roles carried the name to international audiences. This cultural association does not identify the person intended by the supplied token. [Television Academy: Michael Landon](https://www.televisionacademy.com/bios/michael-landon).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语读法记作“兰登”，联想演员 Michael Landon；这是人名，不要与城市 London 混淆。
